o_que_nao_e: Not a direction, not an order, not a target. FUND V0.1 is frozen as an experimental version that failed the directional tests (15 pre-registrations as a predictor; 0 of 9 cells as an entry filter). What is shown here is evidence for you to read, not an edge.
regra_de_leitura: Conviction is coherence with the fundamentals — it is NOT a probability of profit. Thesis health is measured on the raw differential, never on the Score: a Score staying high is not proof of persistence.
